description: This file defines the custom error class `DittoServiceError` which extends Java's `Error` class, representing serious problems in a Ditto service that should not typically be caught.

classes.name: DittoServiceError
classes.description: A custom error class indicating serious, non-recoverable errors in a Ditto service.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the error with a detail message.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the error with a cause.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the error with both a message and a cause.
